headline: Strategy that starts with your next customer, not a template.
subheading: Every engagement begins with understanding who you're actually trying to reach and what they need to hear. The strategy, the copy, the channels, all of it follows from that foundation.

items.title: Target market strategy
items.description: You've been successful with a certain kind of customer. But you can feel there's a bigger opportunity, and maybe you've already had a few early wins with a different type of buyer. This is where we get precise about who that next customer is, what they need to hear, and how to position your business to reach more of them.
deliverables: Positioning statement for your next market

items.title: Sales Enablement
items.description: In most small B2B businesses, the person closing deals is also running the company — or juggling three other roles. I build the messaging, materials, and targeting strategy that make every sales conversation more intentional. So whether it's the CEO walking into a room or a generalist making outreach calls, they're showing up prepared and saying the right thing to the right buyer.

items.title: Copywriting
items.description: Most business copy was written for the customer who got you here. When you're going after someone new, your words need to change too. I write copy that speaks directly to your next buyer in their language, so your website, emails, and materials actually move them to act.

items.title: Digital strategy
items.description: For businesses ready to commit to a new phase of growth. We map where you are, define who your next customer is, and build a complete strategy to reach them — through the right channels, whether that's search, content, outreach, or sales conversations. This is the whole picture, not just one piece of it.

cta.headline: Not sure where to start?
cta.subheading: Book a free call and we'll work out the right first step together. No pitch, no pressure.
